Program_AdminPromptBody:
This tool works best with administrator privileges.

When not running as administrator, some higher-privilege windows may not be pinnable.

Restart as administrator?
Tray_NoActiveWindow: Cannot get the active window. Make sure a window is focused.
Tray_CannotPinBody: This window does not support pinning. It may be a system window or permissions are insufficient.
Tray_OperationErrorBody: An error occurred during the pin operation. See the log for details.
Settings_FilterHint: Tip: ✓ means pinned | type a keyword to filter
Settings_SaveFailedPermissionBody:
Failed to save settings: cannot write the configuration file.
Please check that the program has permission to write to the AppData directory.
About_Feature_Pin_Desc: Keep any window always on top. Operate via the tray menu or the window list in settings.
About_Feature_ClickThrough_Desc: Automatic behavior: single clicks on an inactive pinned window pass through to windows below; a double-click activates the pinned window, after which all actions apply to it normally.
About_Feature_Mini_Desc: Shrink a pinned window into a mini preview to save screen space.
About_Feature_PiP_Desc: Drag a window to the right screen edge to auto-hide it as a picture-in-picture overlay; click the overlay to restore it.
About_Feature_Edge_Desc: Detects the gesture of dragging a window to a screen edge and automatically triggers picture-in-picture mode.
About_Feature_Opacity_Desc: Pinned windows support custom opacity, adjustable in general settings.
About_Feature_Persist_Desc: Automatically saves the pinned window list and restores it after restart.
About_Feature_Tray_Desc: A persistent tray icon with a right-click menu for quick actions; the icon shows the current pinned window count.
About_UsageNote:
Usage tips:
1. On the Window management tab in settings, double-click a window name to pin/unpin it
2. The system tray right-click menu also offers quick actions
3. When a pinned window is inactive, a single click passes through to windows below; a double-click activates that window
Ppc_ConnectionFailedBody:
Could not connect to the PPC server at {0}:{1}, and the automatic attempt to start PPC in a terminal also failed.

Please verify that PPC is installed and try starting it manually.
